title: Alt Text Checker
description: Paste HTML and audit every image's alt text — missing, empty, too-long and filename-as-alt issues flagged in a table.
howto: Paste your page HTML (or just the tags) into the box.
Every image is listed with its alt text and length.
Fix the flagged issues: missing, empty, over 125 chars, or redundant "image of…".

faqs.q: How does it read the alt text?
faqs.a: It parses tags from your HTML with a real attribute parser and extracts the alt and src of each one — all in your browser.

faqs.q: How long should alt text be?
faqs.a: Under ~125 characters. Screen readers may cut off longer text, and concise descriptions rank better for image SEO.

faqs.q: What counts as bad alt text?
faqs.a: Missing or empty alt, alt longer than 125 chars, alt that is just the filename (IMG_2041.jpg), and redundant starts like "image of" or "picture of".
